text:
alex: PSA - onboarding sample for Next+Edge is failing only when built for ESM/adapters. Error: \"TypeError: Class extends value undefined\". Works in local Node.
alex: minimal package.json + tsconfig pasted below.
alex: package.json:
```
{
  \"name\": \"rw-onboard-sample\",
  \"type\": \"module\",
  \"exports\": { \"import\": \"./dist/sdk.mjs\", \"require\": \"./dist/sdk.cjs\" }
}
```
alex: tsconfig:
```
{
  \"compilerOptions\": {
    \"target\": \"ES2020\",
    \"module\": \"ESNext\",
    \"moduleResolution\": \"bundler\",
    \"declaration\": true
  }
}
```
pat: bundlers inline CJS fallback wrappers sometimes. If your package contains a runtime conditional require shim the adapter can rewrite it and end up with undefined, which breaks subclassing.
nora: also saw stray polyfills pulled by the shim that reference `self`/globalThis in edge contexts. That can crash earlier than the class error.
kevin: two parallel fixes: runtime and typing DX. Runtime: for edge samples publish/import ESM-only artifacts (remove CJS shim). Typing: our SDK uses `unknown` in generics which is correct but kills JS inference. Provide a JS-friendly overload and small helper methods.
pat: typing pattern that worked for us:
```
request(path: string, body?: any): Promise<Record<string, any>>;
request<T = unknown>(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T>;
```
That way plain JS gets useful autocomplete while TS stays strict when you opt-in.
alex: tried enabling esModuleInterop and runtime fixed, but some overload tests regressed in CI (inference changed).
nora: so prefer to keep esModuleInterop off. Instead: a) change sample package.json to only import ESM (e.g., \"exports\": { \"import\": \"./dist/sdk.mjs\" }), b) change sample tsconfig.moduleResolution to `node16`, c) add `client.json<T = unknown>()` and `client.any()` helpers for samples.
kevin: also add a tiny post-build test in the sample that constructs the exported class after the adapter build — that would've caught this early.
alex: good call. Also request a CI smoke job that builds the ESM sample and runs it in vercel dev or deno locally.
pat: devx-bot can we get a ticket for that?
devx-bot: created issue #1409: \"ci: smoke-test ESM-only onboarding sample in local edge runtime\" labels: devex/ci, priority/medium. Assigned to @alex.
alex: I'll open a small PR: switch sample to import-only ESM, set moduleResolution to node16 in sample tsconfig, add the typed helpers and post-build constructibility test, and update README with `await client.request<{embedding:number[]}>(...)` and the JS `await client.json('/embed', {q})` example. Will ping for review.
nora: please include the small TS snippet in the PR description so reviewers can validate the inference improvement.
kevin: and add a changelog entry: \"samples: prefer ESM-only artifacts and add JS-friendly typing overloads\".
alex: thanks all, will follow up when CI green.
